title: CERT-In Direction (v) VPN/VPS/cloud-provider subscriber-KYC + 5-year retention with Aadhaar/PAN validation + IP-allocation chain-of-custody
exclusions: Excludes organisations that do not provide VPN, VPS, or cloud services to third-party Indian subscribers (e.g., enterprises operating internal-only IT). Applies primarily to: Indian VPN providers, VPS providers (hosting), cloud service providers (IaaS / PaaS), data centres providing colocation.
evidence: Saved search `UC-22.62.5` archived daily to `audit_evidence` with `cert_in_clause="CERT-In-Dir-5-1"`. Every subscriber pins (subscriber_id, kyc_status, kyc_validation_method, hire_start_at, hire_end_at, ips_allotted, retention_due_until, retention_compliant, risk_score).

compliance.assurance_rationale: CERT-In Direction (v) mandates Data Centres, VPS providers, Cloud Service providers, and VPN providers to register accurate information regarding subscribers/customers for a period of 5 years (or longer if mandated by other law) after any cancellation/withdrawal of the registration. The seven mandatory KYC limbs are: validated names; period of hire including dates; IPs allotted to/being used by the members; email address and IP address and timestamp used at the time of registration / on-boarding; purpose for hiring services; validated address and contact numbers; ownership pattern. This UC enforces all seven limbs.
compliance.controlObjective: Demonstrates that every VPN/VPS/cloud subscriber has a complete 7-limb KYC record retained for 5 years post-deregistration.
compliance.evidenceArtifact: Saved search archived to `audit_evidence`, the `CERT-In Subscriber KYC` dashboard, the per-subscriber KYC record export, the Aadhaar/PAN validation proof.

controlTest.positiveScenario: UC-22.62.5 positive (CERT, Direction, (v), VPN, VPS): ingest synthetic events into `index=target_index` sourcetype='target_sourcetype' where `count` grouped by `entity` satisfies `days_since_deregistration` < 1825, `kyc_limbs_complete` < 5, or `risk_score` > 0 for 'CERT-In Direction (v) VPN/VPS/cloud-provider subscriber-KYC + 5-year retention with Aadhaar/PAN validation + IP-allocation chain-of-custody'.  Run the saved search and confirm at least one alertable row.
controlTest.negativeScenario: UC-22.62.5 negative (of custody): ingest benign `target_index` / `target_sourcetype` events where `entity` stays below `days_since_deregistration` < 1825, `kyc_limbs_complete` < 5, or `risk_score` > 0, or exclude the test entity via `compliance_exception_register.csv`. Variant 1 confirms zero alert rows for 'CERT-In Direction (v) VPN/VPS/cloud-provider subscriber-KYC + 5-year retention with Aadhaar/PAN validation + IP-allocation chain-of-custody'.

dataSources: CRM / subscriber-management system events ingested via HEC `hec:vpn:vps:cloud:subscriber:kyc`. KV Store `cert_in_subscriber_kyc_lookup` (subscriber_id, kyc_limbs, hire_start_at, hire_end_at, deregistered_at). KV Store `cert_in_ip_allocation_lookup` (subscriber_id, ip_address, allocated_at, released_at).
app: Splunk Enterprise Security (Splunkbase 263), Splunk DB Connect (Splunkbase 2686).
spl:
| inputlookup cert_in_subscriber_kyc_lookup
| eval now_ts = now()
| eval kyc_name_present = if(isnotnull(validated_name) AND validated_name != "", 1, 0)
| eval kyc_period_present = if(isnotnull(hire_start_at), 1, 0)
| eval kyc_ips_present = if(isnotnull(ips_allotted) AND ips_allotted != "", 1, 0)
| eval kyc_email_ts_present = if(isnotnull(registration_email) AND isnotnull(registration_ip) AND isnotnull(registration_timestamp), 1, 0)
| eval kyc_purpose_present = if(isnotnull(purpose_of_hire), 1, 0)
| eval kyc_address_present = if(isnotnull(validated_address), 1, 0)
| eval kyc_ownership_present = if(isnotnull(ownership_pattern), 1, 0)
| eval kyc_limbs_complete = kyc_name_present + kyc_period_present + kyc_ips_present + kyc_email_ts_present + kyc_purpose_present + kyc_address_present + kyc_ownership_present
| eval kyc_validation_method_strong = if(kyc_validation_method IN ("aadhaar-otp", "aadhaar-biometric", "pan-validated", "in-person-kyc", "video-kyc"), 1, 0)
| eval days_since_deregistration = if(isnotnull(deregistered_at), round((now_ts - deregistered_at) / 86400, 1), null())
| eval retention_due_until_ts = if(isnotnull(deregistered_at), deregistered_at + (5 * 365.25 * 86400), null())
| eval retention_compliant = case(
    isnull(deregistered_at), 1,
    isnotnull(retention_due_until_ts) AND now_ts <= retention_due_until_ts, 1,
    1=1, 0)
| eval retention_breach = if(isnotnull(deregistered_at) AND days_since_deregistration < 1825 AND retention_compliant = 0, 1, 0)
| eval risk_score = case(
    kyc_limbs_complete < 5, 100,
    kyc_limbs_complete = 5 OR kyc_limbs_complete = 6, 80,
    kyc_validation_method_strong = 0 AND kyc_limbs_complete = 7, 60,
    retention_breach = 1, 95,
    1=1, 0)
| where risk_score > 0
| sort 0 -risk_score, +kyc_limbs_complete
| table subscriber_id kyc_limbs_complete kyc_validation_method kyc_validation_method_strong hire_start_at deregistered_at retention_due_until_ts retention_compliant risk_score
description: Detects of custody activity in UC-22.62.5 ('CERT-In Direction (v) VPN/VPS/cloud-provider subscriber-KYC + 5-year retention with Aadhaar/PAN validation + IP-allocation chain-of-custody') from `index=target_index` sourcetype `configured sourcetype`. Rolls up `count` by `entity` across `the scheduled window` and pages when `days_since_deregistration` < 1825, `kyc_limbs_complete` < 5, or `risk_score` > 0. Covers CERT, Direction, (v), VPN, VPS. Compliance operators treat UC-22.62.5 as the canonical signal.
value: Operators running UC-22.62.5 on UC-22.62.5 search results shorten triage for of custody tied to 'CERT-In Direction (v) VPN/VPS/cloud-provider subscriber-KYC + 5-year retention with Aadhaar/PAN validation + IP-allocation chain-of-custody', lowering audit findings, regulatory gaps, and attestation delays.
implementation: (1) Wire the CRM / subscriber-management system to `hec:vpn:vps:cloud:subscriber:kyc` on every onboarding, change, and deregistration. (2) Enforce the seven KYC limbs in the onboarding form (server-side validation). (3) Implement a 5-year post-deregistration retention policy on the subscriber-management database (legal-hold flag preventing physical deletion). (4) Schedule UC-22.62.5 daily; route `risk_score = 100` to the COO + CISO at severity P1.

references.title: CERT-In Directions of 28 April 2022 — Direction (v) on VPN/VPS/cloud KYC

knownFalsePositives:
1. **Authorised CERT IN control testing** — Internal audit exercises 'CERT-In Direction (v) VPN/VPS/cloud-provider subscriber-KYC + 5-year retention with Aadhaar/PAN validation + IP-allocation chain-of-custody' (UC-22.62.5) on `entity` during scheduled clause CERT-In-Dir-5-1 sampling. Match compliance programme calendar.

2. **External assessor sampling** — QSA activity spikes `index=audit_evidence` `configured sourcetype` without crossing `days_since_deregistration` < 1825. Cross-check engagement letter in `cert_in_exception_register.csv`.

3. **Planned maintenance affecting control telemetry** — CAB change pauses ingestion to `audit_evidence` for `entity`. Compare `_time` with active change record.

4. **Third-party processor under contract** — BAA/DPA-covered vendor generates expected rows grouped by `entity` during normal service delivery.

**Suppression mechanism:** `cert_in_exception_register.csv` keyed on `entity`, `exception_reason`, `valid_until`, joined before alert threshold.
equipmentModels: Splunk DB Connect (CRM / subscriber DB integration)
reviewer: Indian Cybersecurity SME Panel + COO + CISO + Legal
detailedImplementation:
## Prerequisites

- A CRM / subscriber-management system with API hooks for onboarding events.
- UIDAI Aadhaar e-KYC API access via a registered KYC User Agency (KUA) or an Indian-regulated KYC service-provider.
- Indian-jurisdiction subscriber database (UC-22.62.4 retention compliant).

## Step 1 - Subscriber KYC KV Store

```ini
[cert_in_subscriber_kyc_lookup]
enforceTypes = true
field.subscriber_id = string
field.validated_name = string
field.validated_address = string
field.kyc_validation_method = string
field.registration_email = string
field.registration_ip = string
field.registration_timestamp = time
field.purpose_of_hire = string
field.ownership_pattern = string
field.hire_start_at = time
field.hire_end_at = time
field.deregistered_at = time
field.b2b_entity_kyc_ref = string
field.non_aadhaar_validation_method = string
field.legacy_pre_2022 = bool
```

## Step 2 - IP-allocation register

```ini
[cert_in_ip_allocation_lookup]
enforceTypes = true
field.subscriber_id = string
field.ip_address = string
field.allocated_at = time
field.released_at = time
```

## Step 3 - Schedule

```ini
[UC-22.62.5: CERT-In Subscriber KYC]
cron_schedule = 0 5 * * *
dispatch.earliest_time = -1d@d
dispatch.latest_time = now
actions = summary_index, notable
action.summary_index._name = audit_evidence
action.summary_index.marker = uc=22.62.5,reg=CERT-In,clause=CERT-In-Dir-5-1
alert.severity = 4
```

## Step 4 - Indian-jurisdiction-specific notes

- **No-log VPN claims**: a 'no-log' VPN marketing claim is incompatible with Direction (v); providers must choose between Indian-region operations and the no-log brand.
- **Reseller chain**: where a reseller is the immediate counterparty, the principal must require flow-through KYC from the reseller — load `reseller_kyc_chain_ref`.

Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Splunk Enterprise Security (Splunkbase 263), Splunk DB Connect (Splunkbase 2686).). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=see SPL into index=main. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`days_since_deregistration, kyc_address_present, kyc_email_ts_present, kyc_ips_present`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
grandmaExplanation: Indian VPN and cloud providers must keep detailed customer records — including identity, address, and how long they used the service — for 5 years after the customer leaves. We check daily that every customer record is complete and that we still have the records of customers who left up to 5 years ago.
